title: Inception
overview: Dom Cobb is a skilled thief who steals valuable corporate secrets from deep within the subconscious during the dream state. His rare ability has made him a coveted player in industrial espionage, but it has also made him an international fugitive and cost him everything he has ever loved. Now Cobb is offered a chance at redemption with one final impossible job: inception, the reverse of theft, planting an idea into the mind of a CEO. If he succeeds with his elite team, it could be the perfect crime, but a dangerous enemy anticipates their every move.
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Elliot Page

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: Andy Dufresne, a successful banker, is wrongfully convicted of the murder of his wife and her lover and sentenced to two consecutive life terms at Shawshank State Penitentiary. Over the course of nearly two decades, Andy experiences the brutal horrors of prison life, corruption from the sadistic warden, and systemic despair. However, Andy befriends Red, a veteran inmate, and retains an unbreakable sense of hope, intellect, and dignity, secretly planning an ingenious escape that will reclaim his freedom and expose the prison's corruption.
cast: Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman, Bob Gunton

title: Interstellar
overview: In the mid-21st century, Earth is plagued by devastating dust storms, catastrophic crop blights, and famine, threatening human civilization with imminent extinction. Joseph Cooper, a widowed former NASA pilot and farmer, is recruited for a secret space mission through a mysterious wormhole near Saturn. Leaving his beloved children behind with a promise to return, Cooper and a team of researchers embark on an interstellar voyage across uncharted galaxies to locate a viable habitable planet for human survival, wrestling with gravitational time dilation, betrayal, and the transcendental power of love across space and time.
cast: Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway, Jessica Chastain

title: The Dark Knight
overview: With the help of Lieutenant Jim Gordon and newly elected District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague Gotham City. The partnership proves effective, but they soon find themselves targeted by a sadistic criminal mastermind known as the Joker, who plunges Gotham into terrifying anarchy and chaos. The Joker aims to test Batman's moral limits, forcing the Dark Knight to confront intense psychological dread, tragic personal sacrifice, and the razor-thin line between heroism and vigilantism as Harvey Dent falls from grace.
cast: Christian Bale, Heath Ledger, Aaron Eckhart

title: Parasite
overview: The Kim family lives in a cramped semi-basement apartment in Seoul, struggling with extreme poverty and erratic gig work. Opportunity arrives when the son, Ki-woo, is recommended to tutor the daughter of the affluent Park family. One by one, through cunning deceptions and orchestrated lies, the Kims infiltrate the luxurious Park household as indispensable domestic staff. However, their parasitic symbiotic scheme unravels when a dark, shocking secret hidden deep beneath the wealthy mansion surfaces, triggering a violent clash of social class, pride, and desperation.
cast: Song Kang-ho, Lee Sun-kyun, Cho Yeo-jeong

title: Titanic
overview: Eighty-four years after the historic maritime disaster, Rose DeWitt Bukater narrates her poignant journey aboard the ill-fated RMS Titanic. In 1912, seventeen-year-old aristocrat Rose is trapped in an unhappy engagement to an arrogant steel heir, contemplating ending her life until she is saved by Jack Dawson, a free-spirited, impoverished third-class artist. Despite harsh societal class divisions and her mother's disapproval, Jack and Rose fall deeply and passionately in love. Their forbidden romance turns into a harrowing battle for survival when the luxury liner strikes an iceberg in the freezing North Atlantic ocean, demanding heroic sacrifice.
cast: Leonardo DiCaprio, Kate Winslet, Billy Zane

title: The Matrix
overview: Thomas Anderson is a mild-mannered computer programmer by day and an underground hacker named Neo by night. Constantly questioning his own reality, Neo is contacted by Trinity and the enigmatic rebel leader Morpheus, who reveals a shocking, world-shattering revelation: the reality he knows is a simulated virtual construct called the Matrix, created by malevolent sentient machines to pacify humans while harvesting their bioelectric energy. Awakened into the grim, desolate real world, Neo must embrace his destiny as 'The One', waging war against deadly agents and liberating mankind from digital enslavement.
cast: Keanu Reeves, Laurence Fishburne, Carrie-Anne Moss

title: Spirited Away
overview: While moving to a new suburban neighborhood, sullen ten-year-old Chihiro Ogino and her parents inadvertently stumble into an abandoned amusement park that turns out to be a mystical bathhouse resort for spirits, gods, and supernatural beings. When her greedy parents are transformed into pigs after devouring spirit food, Chihiro must overcome her fears and find employment under the tyrannical sorceress Yubaba. Guided by the mysterious river spirit Haku, Chihiro displays remarkable resilience, loyalty, and empathy, embarking on an extraordinary journey to restore her family and reclaim her stolen identity.
cast: Rumi Hiiragi, Miyu Irino, Mari Natsuki

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: The lives of two Los Angeles mob hitmen, Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield, a stylish gangster's wife named Mia Wallace, an aging prizefighter named Butch Coolidge, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four bizarre and violent tales of crime and redemption. Vincent must navigate a dangerous evening entertaining his boss's wife without crossing the line into deadly temptation. Meanwhile, Butch betrays the mob by winning a fixed boxing match, sparking a frantic escape, and Jules experiences a divine miracle during a shootout that inspires him to abandon the criminal underworld in pursuit of spiritual righteousness.
cast: John Travolta, Samuel L. Jackson, Uma Thurman

title: Gladiator
overview: In the year 180 AD, revered Roman general Maximus Decimus Meridius leads his legions to decisive victory against Germanic tribes. Dying Emperor Marcus Aurelius chooses Maximus to succeed him and restore the Roman Republic, but the Emperor's corrupt, jealous son Commodus murders his father and orders the execution of Maximus and his beloved family. Maximus escapes death but arrives too late to save his wife and son, falling into captivity as a slave. Trained as a fierce gladiator, Maximus fights his way to Rome's Colosseum, driven by an unyielding quest for revenge to avenge his murdered family and defy the tyrannical emperor.
cast: Russell Crowe, Joaquin Phoenix, Connie Nielsen

title: Whiplash
overview: Andrew Neiman is an ambitious nineteen-year-old jazz drummer studying at the prestigious Shaffer Conservatory in New York City, determined to become one of the all-time greats like Buddy Rich. He is recruited into the top studio ensemble by Terence Fletcher, an extraordinarily ruthless and psychologically abusive conductor who believes in pushing students beyond human endurance through terrifying public humiliation and physical intimidation. As Andrew becomes consumed by singular obsession, he sacrifices his relationships, sanity, and physical well-being, culminating in an electrifying climactic performance that tests the boundary between artistic brilliance and monstrous self-destruction.
cast: Miles Teller, J.K. Simmons, Paul Reiser

title: Coco
overview: In the vibrant town of Santa Cecilia, twelve-year-old Miguel Rivera dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol Ernesto de la Cruz, despite his family's generations-old strict ban on music. Desperate to prove his musical talent, Miguel accidentally crosses into the stunning, colorful Land of the Dead on Dia de los Muertos. Partnering with a charming trickster named Héctor, Miguel embarks on an extraordinary journey through the afterlife to uncover the true mystery behind his family history, the enduring power of unconditional love, and the sacred importance of never forgetting ancestors.
cast: Anthony Gonzalez, Gael García Bernal, Benjamin Bratt

title: The Prestige
overview: In late 19th-century Victorian London, two ambitious stage magicians and former partners, Robert Angier and Alfred Borden, become bitter rivals following a tragic onstage accident that claims the life of Angier's wife. Their competition escalates into a fierce, obsessive feud to create the ultimate stage illusion: the Teleported Man. As Borden masters the trick through mysterious discipline, Angier turns to brilliant inventor Nikola Tesla to build a dangerous scientific apparatus. Their escalating rivalry drives them to betrayal, murder, and unimaginable sacrifice as both men surrender their morality for theatrical glory.
cast: Hugh Jackman, Christian Bale, Scarlett Johansson

title: Forrest Gump
overview: Sitting on a park bench in Savannah, Georgia, Forrest Gump, a gentle and kind-hearted man with a low IQ, recounts his remarkable life story to listening strangers. From running across Alabama as a boy to becoming a college football star, decorated Vietnam war hero, ping-pong champion, and shrimp boat entrepreneur, Forrest inadvertently witnesses and influences monumental historical events of the late 20th century. Through decades of triumph, hardship, and loss, Forrest remains loyal to his mother's wise lessons and steadfast in his lifelong, unrequited love for his troubled childhood sweetheart, Jenny Curran.
cast: Tom Hanks, Robin Wright, Gary Sinise

title: Alien
overview: The commercial deep-space towing vessel Nostromo is returning to Earth when its computer system intercepts a mysterious transmission from an uncharted moon. The crew is awakened from stasis to investigate the desolate alien moon, where executive officer Kane discovers a derelict extraterrestrial vessel containing thousands of organic eggs. A predatory parasitic organism attaches to Kane's face, and despite quarantine protocols, he is brought back aboard. Soon, a ferocious, acid-blooded alien creature bursts into the ship, stalking and slaughtering the isolated crew one by one in dark corridors as warrant officer Ellen Ripley fights for survival.
cast: Sigourney Weaver, Tom Skerritt, John Hurt
